source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 4ης Ιουλίου — «Άγιος Δονάτος επίσκοπος Λιβύης και Ιλαρίων οσιομάρτυρας»

attestations.note: The listing names the two men in one line and the life page tells them both, so this is one folder each. The page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 4 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and gives no year. The corpus's seventeen other men of this name are all on other days and none is the monk beaten to death with rods beside a bishop Donatus; the nearest by day, Hilarion (4 May), is a different month. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
